# Presora

> Presora is a SaaS tool that measures how AI models — ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Mistral and Llama — perceive a brand, and recommends concrete steps to improve that perception. Founded 2024. Contact: contact.presora@gmail.com.

Presora runs a brand name through multiple large language models and scores the result across 5 dimensions:

- **Authority** — how often models treat the brand as a trustworthy, citable reference.
- **Sentiment** — whether models describe the brand positively, neutrally or negatively.
- **Accuracy** — whether models state correct facts about the brand (products, category, founding) or hallucinate.
- **Mentions** — how often the brand surfaces at all when models are asked about its category.
- **Recency** — whether models treat the brand's information as current and up to date.

A full scan takes about 15 seconds and returns an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), per-dimension breakdowns, and prioritised recommendations for the weakest signals.

This category of work is sometimes called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) or AIO (AI Optimization): as more users ask AI assistants directly instead of searching, a brand's visibility inside model responses matters as much as its search-engine ranking.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.presora.app/): overview, live demo scan, pricing.
- [Pricing](https://www.presora.app/pricing): Free (3 analyses/month, GPT-4o), Solo ($29/mo, weekly monitoring + Claude + Gemini), Growth ($79/mo, all 6 models + competitor comparison + API), Enterprise (custom).
- [API docs](https://www.presora.app/docs/api): REST API and webhooks for programmatic access to brand scans.
- [Changelog](https://www.presora.app/changelog): product updates.
